view.name: Article reader
view.description: Full-text article reader with title, date, feed/source/bookmark/like/markdown action chips, an AI summary callout and the article body, plus a floating chat button.

regions.label: Minimal top bar with only a back chevron button
H1 title, date, feed-name chip, Source Article link, bookmark, like (pressed), copy-as-Markdown buttons
Grey callout with blue left rule: one-line summary + bullet points, truncated with Read more / Show less toggle
Long-form article body in a 592px column: blue H2s, paragraphs, syntax-highlighted code blocks, linked trace-viewer screenshots
Fixed round blue Chat button bottom-right

evidence.note: Article reader view: title, date, source feed, bookmark button and summary block above the body
Summary of the article shown before the text (reading assistance), expandable
evidence.quote: Flight recorder provides always-on execution tracing with minimal overhead for production debugging.

evidence.note: Continuous-scroll long-form text in a narrow measured column
Thumbs-up icon button in pressed state (blue), no count shown; personal like on the article

patterns.rationale: Only a floating 'Chat' launcher button is visible; clicking it on the live copy did not reveal a visible chat panel, so the thread/composer could not be verified. Likely an article-scoped AI chat in this reader app.

evidence.note: Fixed round blue chat-bubble button labelled Chat
Summary is likely model-generated but carries no AI label, model name or citations
Read more/Show less is a single truncation toggle, not stacked expandable sections
Only a back button; no global navigation visible in this view

structure.layout: single-column article reader: centered 592px text column inside a 672px article, minimal back-button header, metadata/action chips, summary callout, long body with code blocks and images, fixed chat FAB

aesthetics.typography: ui-sans-serif system stack (renders as Arial/Liberation-like sans) for title, headings, body and chips; ui-monospace for inline code and code blocks with GitHub-light syntax colors; Noto Sans on header/FAB buttons
aesthetics.typeScale: H1 28px bold #111; H2 22px bold in brand blue #2563eb; body 16px regular with very open ~29px line-height; code 14px mono; meta date 14px grey; chips 13px; Read more 12px blue

notes: Oksskolten reader view. Distinctive: H2 section headings colored brand blue rather than black; summary callout is #f7f7f7 with a thick 4px blue left border and a tiny 12px 'Read more' link that expands bullets in place ('Show less'). Action row is a set of small 26px-tall outlined chips (feed name, Source Article ↗, bookmark, thumbs-up filled blue when pressed, M↓ markdown export). Code blocks use #f7f7f7 panels with GitHub-light syntax highlighting and horizontal overflow. Only chrome is a back chevron top-left and a round blue Chat FAB bottom-right with shadow. No visible AI labelling on the summary.
